requirement.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF a ship is not category A and is designed to operate in at least thin first-year ice, including possible old-ice inclusions, THEN ship_category = 'B'.
requirement.requiredInputs: Ship design ice condition and declared Polar Code category
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: Category B ship means a ship not included in category A, designed for operation in polar waters in at least thin first-year ice, which may include old ice inclusions.
